power.planning_not_observed: No C/D predictions exist; the 10% disagreement rate is an illustrative assumption, not a measured project quantity.
power.approximation: For paired binary differences d in {-1,0,1}, Var(d)=q-delta^2. Near the null, SE approximately sqrt(q/n). MDE approximately (z_.975+z_.8)*sqrt(q/n).
power.seed_correlation: The single-seed planning calculation is not the MDE of a three-seed mean. Actual uncertainty depends on covariance across seeds within questions. Keep each question across all arms/seeds as one cluster; also report seed dispersion.
actual_reporting: mean paired accuracy difference and question-cluster interval
power.decision: An interval spanning zero or substantial seed inconsistency is inconclusive, not proof of equivalence. Do not move the primary claim to a more favorable diagnostic after observing results.
power.extra_benchmarks: GSM8K remains the prespecified transfer evaluation. No new benchmark is silently added to the primary pooled endpoint; any additional set requires contamination audit and a separate stated estimand.

resource_gate.status: prospective engineering resource rule; not yet evaluated
resource_gate.freeze_time: Declared before C/D adaptation, shared-probe scoring and B/C/D RL; after A/17 baseline evidence already existed. Not claimed preregistered before all project results.
resource_gate.models: Apply once to C and D adapted with seed 17; score the same 64-question, eight-response-per-question initial-policy probe. Other selected PRM seeds are adapted later for their paired runs.
resource_gate.eligibility: All 64 fixed groups and all 512 responses must be retained; finite, validated scores and actual GRPO advantages are required. Use the same invalid/truncation handling as training. Missing responses or failed audits block the decision, not trigger the reduced branch.
resource_gate.advantage_definition: A_{h,i}=(R_{h,i}-mean_j R_{h,j})/(sample_std_j R_{h,j}+1e-4), computed separately for C/D on the identical eight responses in question group h.
resource_gate.sign_definition: sign_eps(a)=0 when abs(a)<=1e-6, +1 when a>1e-6, otherwise -1; same dead band for C and D, fixed before scoring.
resource_gate.sign_agreement: mean_{h,i} 1[sign_eps(A_C[h,i])==sign_eps(A_D[h,i])] over all 512 responses, with zero/nonzero counts disclosed.
resource_gate.group_rms_definition: d_h=sqrt((1/8)*sum_i (A_C[h,i]-A_D[h,i])**2); use max_h d_h over all 64 groups, not a pooled mean that can hide a rare large change.
resource_gate.decision: PASS only if sign agreement >=0.99 AND max_h d_h <=0.05, following a passed technical audit. PASS -> [17] for every A/B/C/D arm. FAIL -> planned [17,42,83] for every arm. Lock and record before B/C/D RL.
resource_gate.interpretation: 0.99 and 0.05 are prespecified compute-saving heuristics, not learned cutoffs, significance levels or a proven bound on policy-gradient differences, future-policy behavior or accuracy. Typical nondegenerate group-normalized advantages have order-one scale, but small probe RMS does not imply small parameter-gradient changes.
resource_gate.evidence_reporting: Save probe trajectory manifest, PRM hashes, numerical audit, all advantages and group RMS values, aggregate agreement including zero pairs, outcome-stratified diagnostics, selected seed list, timestamp and planned token total. Report a triggered gate as a resource decision and one-seed findings as exploratory.
resource_gate.no_adaptive_reversal: Do not use seed-17 accuracy or ProcessBench to expand, reverse the gate, choose a PRM or change thresholds. Any later extension is a separately documented follow-up, not part of this locked comparison.
resource_gate.not_authorization: This document amendment does not launch or modify any run.
